Direct owners in configured order

  • app-ops — node-a-app (lan, operator hint): ops-app@node-a.example.invalid:22; trust example-owner-trust

Hints are not host trust, reachability, or permission. Authenticate independently.

Workflow

  1. Use the advertised tools and domain repositories as hints; independently verify source identity and enrolled SSH host trust. Forgejo API/Git access is not owner SSH authority.
  2. Retrieve both sources in a private task workspace; use an independently verified native installation bundle and a new user-level Python virtual environment. Do not run sudo pip or require a container engine.
  3. Select the domain directory and your reviewed SSH configuration explicitly. Do not automatically execute repository SSH ProxyCommand or Match directives.
  4. Run domain-ops --domain <domain-path> info --json and then status. Local info does not prove remote permissions; receiving host-ops/app-ops authorize each operation.
  5. Inspect, test, plan and confirm before mutations. Local owners retain accepted work; Forgejo Issues and optional reference reports are nonblocking conveniences. No directory tool performs these steps.

Recovery

Use the independent owner-held native recovery kit; direct owner SSH needs separately enrolled credentials.
